task.description: WF-02 Step 2d -- Idiom review for REQ-367 (CD to QA deploy infra). Claim this handoff (status IN_PROGRESS). Read the diff (git diff main...HEAD) and follow .claude/agents/reviewer.md's four questions, adapted for this non-Elixir infra change: (1) idiomatic vs. crutch -- does deploy/redeploy-qa.sh follow the SAME conventions as the existing deploy/redeploy-test.sh (set -euo pipefail, retry-loop health-check shape, variable naming), or does it invent a divergent style with no stated reason? (2) supervision integrity -- N/A for this change (no OTP supervision tree touched), state that explicitly. (3) type-safety / correctness gaps -- for shell+YAML, the equivalent is: does the script fail loudly (exit non-zero) on every real failure path rather than silently continuing? Does cd.yml's gate correctly fail-safe (does an artifact-download failure cause a silent no-deploy or a loud error)? (4) scope creep -- is the one additive step to ci.yml's changes job (already ruled legitimate minimal scope by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, see step-01b's ci_yml_scope_ruling) still genuinely minimal in the actual implementation, or did ELIXIR-DEV's implementation add anything beyond what was designed/ruled? Also check docs/anti-patterns.md for any relevant prior finding this change might repeat. Check consistency with docs/migration/decisions/ -- particularly whether this diverges from any documented CI/CD decision without a stated reason (the design's §0 already addresses the letflow-queue-pattern-reuse question; confirm the implementation matches what was cited, not something else). FAIL if a genuine crutch, unexplained divergence, silent-failure path, or unjustified scope creep is found; otherwise PASS with any non-blocking notes recorded. Complete the handoff: PASS -> next_action 'Route to TEST-DESIGNER (3)' | FAIL -> next_action 'Rework ELIXIR-DEV'. Commit and push on feature/WF02-REQ367-20260917.
